protocol.large_ssd_prefill: offline warm before every InfiniDisk2 large stage, including baseline
protocol.durability: InnoDB fsync=1, sync_binlog=1, doublewrite ON; InfiniDisk2 local WAL fsync; ZeroFS durable S3 and ignored-fsync modes reported separately
protocol.recovery: write and qualification stages include MySQL SIGKILL + CHECK TABLE; read-only screening reuses validated fixture and explicitly skips that repeated check
protocol.selection: highest geometric mean of small read_write/write_only TPS, choosing simpler profile within 3%; reject candidates with ignored SQL errors; use NBD for conservative qualification
protocol.limitations: single VM and evolving fixed-size database; no global cache drop; Linux page cache outside configured engine RAM; screening has one sample; host services remain running
protocol.reuse_policy: Qualification/confirmation/controls require matching binary, parameters, raw proof and config digests. Historical screenings are explicitly retained only for profile selection.
protocol.sql_error_policy: Any ignored SQL error excludes the complete stage from performance comparisons; preserve counters and do not automatically repeat to obtain a cleaner score.

Controlled warm sweep 8/16/32/64/128 complete with original caches restored. All qualification uses b39b705; prior screenings remain selection-only. selection.explanation: geometric mean of small write/mixed throughput, with simpler profile selected within 3%; ublk remains separately measured because screen covered reads only

sql_diagnostics.scope: separate fixed diagnostic; no replacement samples; historical events remain individually unidentified
sql_diagnostics.result: reproduced two InnoDB transaction deadlocks (1213, SQLSTATE 40001); no lock timeout in this diagnostic

final_confirmations.protocol: small fixture, 3 samples of 30s per workload, NBD then ublk; separate engine SIGKILL during mixed writes, ext4 recovery and InnoDB CHECK TABLE; process cgroup v2 CPU counters sampled

cpu_controls.protocol: Separate CPU-quota diagnostic, not a replacement for the 1-CPU campaign. Baseline/Astra NBD/native, small mixed then large uniform read-only; same seed, configured caches and warmup durations. Cache banks preserve only disposable cache files; every large InfiniDisk2 stage still runs complete warm.

transport_comparison.protocol: Large uniform read-only with the same selected profile and configured caches as NBD; only ublk_fast_path and transport differ. Quotas 1 and 2 CPU are reported separately from the six CPU-quota stages.
